title: Dubai Land Department (DLD) Fees & Closing Costs
content: When purchasing property in Dubai, buyers must pay a mandatory 4% Dubai Land Department (DLD) transfer fee based on the property purchase price, plus an administrative trustee fee of AED 4,200 for properties valued at AED 500,000 or more (or AED 2,100 below AED 500,000). Title deed issuance costs AED 580. For secondary market transactions, standard brokerage agency commission is 2% plus 5% VAT. Off-plan direct developer purchases carry 0% agency commission.

title: UAE 10-Year Golden Visa via Real Estate Investment
content: Property investors in Dubai qualify for the 10-Year UAE Golden Visa if they purchase one or more properties with a total minimum value of AED 2,000,000 (2 Million AED). Under updated Dubai regulations, off-plan properties from approved developers and mortgaged properties also qualify, provided the property value meets the AED 2M threshold and a No Objection Certificate (NOC) is obtained from the developer or bank. Golden Visa holders can sponsor their spouse, children, and domestic staff.

title: RERA Escrow Protection & Off-Plan Payment Plans
content: All off-plan real estate projects in Dubai are strictly regulated by RERA (Real Estate Regulatory Agency). Buyer installment payments must be deposited directly into a project-specific government-monitored Escrow Account, never into a developer's personal account. Typical off-plan payment plans follow a 60/40 structure (60% paid during construction milestones, 40% upon handover) or post-handover plans extending 2 to 3 years after completion.

title: Brokerage Governance & Deal Approval Protocol
content: AI assistants may autonomously provide general market policies, DLD fee explanations, and public brochure details for properties below AED 1,000,000. However, any formal price quotation, customized payment plan negotiation, private VIP property viewing request, or purchase inquiry involving properties valued at AED 1,000,000 or above MUST be routed for Senior Broker approval before sending a final commitment to the client.
